You can also use pay-as-you-go without logging in.

By registering to the service, you'll be able to access thousands of free chargers around Europe and enjoy typically lower prices for charging. We will bill your payment card monthly according to your charging spending.

In the app you can:

- Charge at home, at work and on the move. Just plug in your car - we’ll do the rest
- View a real-time map of the state of charging points (Available – Charging – Out of order)
- Navigate to the charging location
- Start and stop charging
- Monitor your charging power remotely

Our 24/7 help desk is available in several languages.
